channel.description: Latest articles from Best Media Info (bestmediainfo.com)

item.title: BIF flags ‘serious concerns’ over SIM-binding rule, urges govt to pause rollout
item.description: BIF said that the directions raise significant questions of jurisdiction, consumer impact, and risk, creating obligations that extend far beyond the mandate of the Telecom Act or the purpose of the Telecom Cyber Security Rules

item.title: Laqshya StoryWorks strengthens leadership with Nandan as Creative Head and Bhattacharya as National Sales Head
item.description: Nandan and Bhattacharya bring decades of experience in storytelling, content creation, branded solutions and media monetisation across top networks

item.title: Sanchar Saathi ‘not a snooping app’, says Scindia as Opposition attacks pre-install mandate
item.description: Communications Minister insists the fraud-busting app is optional and deletable, even as Opposition flags privacy, consent and surveillance concerns over DoT’s March 2026 pre-installation order

item.title: Kevin Vaz bets on AI, connected TV and micro-dramas as JioStar’s next growth drivers
item.description: Speaking at Asia TV Forum & Market 2025 in Singapore, Vaz stressed that JioStar sees its women-led dramas, youth-skewing non-fiction, kids slate and sports portfolio as pillars it will keep investing in, even as distribution methods evolve

item.title: CNBC-TV18 and IndiaBonds launch ‘Bond Street’ to explain India’s corporate bond market
item.description: The initiative will deliver daily news and weekly expert analysis, helping investors understand India’s corporate bond market and navigate its evolving landscape

item.title: Netflix cuts mobile casting on most smart TVs, leaving users to rely on remotes
item.description: Netflix has updated its device support, limiting casting to certain TVs while discontinuing AirPlay and Google TV app streaming options

item.title: Omnicom Media names Kartik Sharma CEO, Amardeep Singh COO, Shashi Sinha Strategic Advisor for India
item.description: The India structure sits within a wider regional reset that brings together the media operations of OMG and Mediabrands under the Omnicom Media banner across APAC

item.title: SC refuses to interfere with SEBI’s Rs 30 lakh fine on RIL over Jio–Facebook disclosure lapse
item.description: The matter stems from SEBI’s view that RIL delayed sharing UPSI on Facebook’s planned Jio stake, even as reports of the deal appeared in global media ahead of the formal disclosure

item.title: Altman’s ‘code red’ puts ChatGPT advertising discussions back at the forefront
item.description: An internal memo suggests OpenAI is revisiting advertising for ChatGPT, with Sam Altman declaring a ‘code red’ to focus on product improvements while other plans slow down
